reuse.why: Fintegra links through a new shared linkProviderAccount (which keeps calling assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse) and downloads through a shared downloadProviderTransactions also used by Pluggy.ai and Akahu.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a sixth copy of the link body and a third copy of the downloader, it collapses the five existing link copies and two download copies into single definitions with thin per-provider wrappers.

placement.why: Link logic stays in accounts/app.ts, download logic in accounts/sync.ts and the base path in server-config.ts, as the tree organises providers.

scope.why: The consolidation rewrites every existing provider's link and Pluggy/Akahu download paths, well beyond adding Fintegra, which widens the review surface of a feature change.

maintainability.why: One link function and one downloader make future providers trivial; the institution override, the newAccountFields escape hatch for GoCardless and the cast on institution are slightly awkward.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through linkProviderAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked; Fintegra download goes through downloadProviderTransactions.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated provider bodies are removed and shared, not reshaped.
